title: TOEIC® Listening - Versión 10: Strategic Planning & Restructuring
description: Prueba intensiva de comprensión auditiva TOEIC® enfocada en el contexto de Summit Media con the CEO.

parts.visual:
## 📸 Simulación de Auditiva: Summit Media

Evaluaremos tu destreza auditiva en el contexto de **Summit Media** (Líder a cargo: **the CEO**).

Concéntrate plenamente en las descripciones y los audios corporativos.
parts.audio: Welcome to this specialized TOEIC Listening drill. Listen closely to the speaker options and pick the best description of the workspace. Good luck!

questions.question: [PART 1 - PHOTOGRAPH]: Look at the business picture of Summit Media's office staff. Select the correct description.
questions.audio_script: A) They are drawing the organizational chart. B) They are leaving the executive boardroom. C) The strategy office is empty. D) They are reviewing the corporate acquisition plan.
questions.explanation: Se observa a la mesa directiva analizando el organigrama y el dossier de adquisición estratégica.

questions.question: [PART 3 - CONVERSATION]: Listen to the conversation and answer: What is the main issue discussed by the speakers?
questions.audio_script:
M: Hi Robert, did you review the expansion plan from Summit Media?
W: Yes, the CEO sent it. All departmental goals must be mapped under ActiveCRM.
M: I will synchronize the task boards today.
options: The contract pricing is too high.
The delivery window is too narrow for their schedule.
They want to cancel the shipment.
The company wants to buy ApexCRM.
questions.correct_answer: The delivery window is too narrow for their schedule.
questions.explanation: La mujer menciona explícitamente: 'pricing is competitive, but their delivery window is too narrow for our schedule'.
